notes: Wildwood Scourge (M21): 'Whenever ONE OR MORE +1/+1 counters are put on another non-Hydra creature you control, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' With Conclave Mentor ('If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one ... instead'): the Scourge cast with X=1 enters with 2 counters. Tempered Veteran puts one counter on the Bear, Mentor makes it two at once: ONE trigger, whose single counter Mentor also makes two. Scourge: 2 + 2 = 4 (a trigger per counter would give 6). Bear: 2.
